lines.text: Tycho steps out of the portal, back into the evening air.
Back out. Same field, same sky. The passage holds in both directions, then.
Let me check in with my sister. She will want to see this. And maybe we can take advantage of it.
He finds Sophia at her workbench, bent over her instruments.

Sophia! Sorry to interrupt your work, but this might be of interest to you too. While out in the fields, I fell into a cave, touched some foreign object, got some etchings and seemingly power, and entered a portal. There is a whole structure in there, full of monsters. You can see the etchings on my arm for yourself.
What are you talking about? I might think you went insane, but I see your forearms, which give some credibility to your story. Show me what you found, you can explain on the way
So here was the object, it dissolved after I touched it and opened this portal.
This goes against my every theory I had about how the world actually works. But maybe it runs on divine energy after all? On magic? I need to see this for myself
Sophia steps toward the portal. It does not let her through.

I cannot go through. Probably keyed to you, as it got created at the same time as your etchings. What a shame. Well, you are the one out in the field anyway. Make sure to bring back as much as you can. We want to study this.
Sure will do. Probably better that only I can enter, as it's quite dangerous in there.
This is something huge and something completely unknown to us. It is imperative that you continue researching it, and bring back everything you can find
Did not have anything else in mind.
